mapper.select: SELECT -- 拼接详细标题：gene-基因ID_染色体:起始-结束_类型 CONCAT( 'gene-', g.gene_id, '_', g.chr, ':', g.start, '-', g.end, '_', #{sequenceType} ) AS id, gs.sequence FROM genome_sequence gs JOIN gene g ON gs.gene_id = g.gene_id WHERE gs.gene_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{geneIds[0]}, '%') -- 模糊匹配（适配多个基因ID） AND gs.sequence_type = #{sequenceType}

SELECT -- 拼接mRNA标题：gene-基因ID_转录本ID_染色体:起始-结束_mrna CONCAT( 'gene-', t.gene_id, '_', t.transcript_id, '_', t.chr, ':', t.start, '-', t.end, '_mrna' ) AS id, fs.sequence FROM transcript t JOIN feature_sequence fs ON t.transcript_id = fs.feature_id -- 转录本ID=特征ID WHERE t.gene_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{geneIds[0]}, '%') -- 模糊匹配基因ID

SELECT -- 拼接外显子标题：gene-基因ID_外显子ID_染色体:起始-结束_exons CONCAT( 'gene-', t.gene_id, '_', f.feature_id, '_', f.chr, ':', f.start, '-', f.end, '_exons' ) AS id, fs.sequence FROM transcript t JOIN feature f ON t.transcript_id = f.transcript_id -- 转录本关联外显子 JOIN feature_sequence fs ON f.feature_id = fs.feature_id -- 外显子ID=特征ID WHERE t.gene_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{geneIds[0]}, '%') -- 模糊匹配基因ID AND f.feature_type = 'exon' -- 仅查外显子

SELECT -- 拼接CDS标题：gene-基因ID_CDSID_染色体:起始-结束_cds CONCAT( 'gene-', t.gene_id, '_', f.feature_id, '_', f.chr, ':', f.start, '-', f.end, '_cds' ) AS id, fs.sequence FROM transcript t JOIN feature f ON t.transcript_id = f.transcript_id -- 转录本关联CDS JOIN feature_sequence fs ON f.feature_id = fs.feature_id -- CDS ID=特征ID WHERE t.gene_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{geneIds[0]}, '%') -- 模糊匹配基因ID AND f.feature_type = 'CDS' -- 仅查CDS
SELECT transcript_id FROM transcript WHERE gene_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{geneId}, '%')
